alex.s: Quick check — planning to flip canary toggles for model v4.2 tomorrow 08:00 PDT. Proposed plan: region-first (us-west -> us-east -> eu-west) with percent ramps per region: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 50%. Need guardrails, rollback thresholds, and who owns the playbook?

sara.k: Prefer starting at 0.5% for 30m in us-west, then 2% for 1h before bigger jumps. Also need clear SLO gates (latency, errors) and an eval check for hallucination regressions.

ben_p: Sounds fine. My suggestion: automated ramping that only advances if p95 < 500ms and error_rate < 0.5% over the last 10m. If either fails, pause and page eng-oncall. Example config I can wire into toggle-service: 

```json
{
  "feature": "model_v4_2_canary",
  "scope": [
    {"region": "us-west", "steps": [0.5, 2, 10, 50]},
    {"region": "us-east", "steps": [1, 5, 20, 50]},
    {"region": "eu-west", "steps": [1, 5, 20, 50]}
  ],
  "checks": {
    "p95_latency_ms": 500,
    "error_rate_pct": 0.5,
    "lookback_minutes": 10
  }
}
```

marta: +1 to automated gates. Also add explicit fallback policy: route to v4.1 if errors > 1% OR if hallucination metric regresses by >3% on our eval set. We should tag traces and sample full requests for debugging.

infra-bot: infra-check: OK — capacity reserved in us-west (4 GPUs), no quota blocks. No infra alerts affecting those regions.

alex.s: Thanks. Sara — can you own the rollout doc and ops coordination? Ben — please add the automated gating to toggle-service and put the rollout config in a PR. I'll schedule the canary at 08:00 PDT and notify #eng-oncall 30m before.

sara.k: I can own it. I'll update the rollout doc, add the thresholds, and ping #eng-oncall 30m prior. Also will enable KMS audit logs for private tenants during the window.

ben_p: @marta — are you oncall tomorrow morning? If not, we need to arrange backup.

marta: I'm oncall 08:00-12:00 PT tomorrow, I'll watch dashboards and be ready to trigger rollback.

alex.s: Quick operational rules:
- If 5xx increases but latency is stable, prefer HOLD (do not ramp) until we identify cause.
- If error_rate > 1% OR p95 > 1000ms OR hallucination-regress > 3% then immediate rollback to v4.1 + incident. :warning:

sara.k: Noted. I'll codify these into the playbook. Proposed explicit thresholds to include in the doc:
- hold if 5xx delta > 0.3% vs baseline (5m avg)
- rollback if 5xx > 1% OR p95 > 1000ms OR hallucination-regress > 3%

ben_p: I'll open a PR linking the toggle config to CI gating and add automated actions (pause/rollback). Will also include a smoke test that hits a small set of deterministics. PR when ready: https://git.redwood.ai/repo/toggle-service/pulls/721

infra-bot: maintenance-window reserved: 2026-03-18T08:00:00-07:00 (canary).

alex.s: One more: enable log sampling at 1% for full request+response body for the first 2 hours, tag logs with `canary_v4_2`. Also enable trace sampling at 5% and surface a distributed trace link in the canary dashboard. Sara, please enable KMS audit logs for any private tenants impacted.

sara.k: Will enable logs and traces, and add the KMS audit toggle.

marta: Good to go from SRE side. I'll have rollback command ready and a short checklist by EOD. :thumbsup:

ben_p: PR opened and CI checks added (see link). I'll leave a note in the PR for manual approval after docs are updated.

alex.s: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll post a reminder 30m before the window. If anything changes overnight, @here ping me.

infra-bot: reminder scheduled for 2026-03-18T07:30:00-07:00.
